seo.title: Privacy Policy
seo.description: Learn how diBoaS collects, uses, and protects your personal data. GDPR compliant.

header.title: Privacy Policy
header.intro: diBoaS ("we," "us," "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
header.notice: Updated on November 25, 2026: the signup forms have a separate, unticked box for noting which button or campaign link brought you, which you can remove from the "Email settings" page; we corrected the legal basis for measuring site use and how long analytics data is kept.

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.content: diBoaS is a financial technology platform. We are the data controller for personal data collected through our website and services.

whatDataWeCollect.title: What Data We Collect

provided.title: Information You Provide:
items: If you tick the box on the signup form: which button or campaign link brought you to our waitlist

automatic.title: Information Collected Automatically:
items: IP address (used for security rate limiting and audit logging, retained up to 90 days; not sent to analytics services)
Which signup form you used, and a friend's invitation code if you used one
Your country, worked out from your connection or, when it can be guessed, from your browser's language

whatDataWeCollect.signupRecords: Whatever you choose, a signup records which signup form you used, your country (worked out from your connection or, when it can be guessed, from your browser's language) and, if you sign up through a form on the site's pages after opening a friend's invitation link in the same browser tab, or you typed their invite code, that friend's code.

rows.purpose: Measure how visitors use the site (Google Analytics, PostHog)
Note which button or campaign link brought you to our waitlist
rows.legalBasis: Your consent (the box on the signup form), for notes saved from November 25, 2026

whoWeShareWith.title: Who We Share Data With
whoWeShareWith.intro: We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with:

serviceProviders.title: Service Providers:
serviceProviders.content: Resend (email delivery), Vercel (hosting), Sentry (error monitoring), Google Analytics and PostHog (analytics, only after your consent), Upstash (security rate limiting)

legal.title: Legal Requirements:
legal.content: When required by law or to protect our rights

whoWeShareWith.note: All service providers are contractually bound to protect your data.

internationalTransfers.title: International Transfers
internationalTransfers.content: Your data may be transferred to countries outside the European Economic Area (EEA). We ensure appropriate safeguards through Standard Contractual Clauses or adequacy decisions.

items.duration: Until you unsubscribe or 2 years after last interaction
Google Analytics: up to 14 months after your last visit. PostHog: 12 months.

Kept with your waitlist signup until you remove it on the email-preferences page (the "Email settings" link in our emails) or ask us to remove it or to delete your signup. Campaign values and button labels our analytics tools receive with your cookie consent follow their own retention.

yourRights.title: Your Rights (GDPR)

rows.description: Request a copy of your personal data
Limit how we process your data
Receive your data in a portable format
Object to processing based on legitimate interest

yourRights.exerciseRights: To exercise your rights, email {email}. We will respond within 30 days.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.content: If you believe we have violated your privacy rights, you may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

security.title: Security
security.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including:

childrenPrivacy.title: Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.content: diBoaS is not intended for children under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this policy. Material changes will be communicated via email or website notice.
